title: ANDS Studio — AI-assisted drafting
walkthrough:
You are inside a dossier section's work panel. An eyebrow line reads "Module … · Section … ·" then an applicability badge, and — when the leaf is placed — "· Placed at …folder… · leaf …". Below sit the section title, a one-line purpose, and a box headed "What Health Canada needs here" with the guidance text. A collapsed "Format & source" disclosure hides the format/bilingual chips and a "Health Canada guidance ↗" link.

An action bar labelled "Choose how to complete this section" holds toggle buttons, each with a small icon: "Upload", "Author in-app", and "Mark N/A". Choosing "Author in-app" on an AI-enabled section reveals a second toggle: "💬 Draft with AI" (default) and "Fill the form".

In "Draft with AI" you read a grey note: "Chat with an AI assistant to draft this document — it will ask for any details it needs instead of leaving blanks. Nothing is saved until you click Use this draft. The saved draft is checked by ANDS Studio's structural completeness check (a technical checker modeled on HC criteria — not HC's official eValidator), and stays not-yet-filable until you review and confirm it." An empty thread shows "Tell it about the submission to get started — it knows what [section title] needs." You type into a two-row box (placeholder "e.g. Sponsor is Acme Pharma Inc., contact regulatory@acme.example") and press "Send"; Enter also sends. The button reads "Thinking…" while the reply streams in as chat bubbles.

Once a reply finishes, a "Use this draft →" button appears ("Saving…" while it works). Clicking it saves the latest AI reply. A success toast confirms it, and a saved-document card appears showing a 💬 icon, the filename, the size, a "fingerprint md5 …" label with the checksum's first eight characters, a provenance chip, and a "Download" link. Hovering the chip shows a tooltip stating the draft was made under your direction and recorded in the audit trail; that your dossier text is sent to the configured AI provider for this draft only, isolated per sponsor, never shared across clients or used to train models; and that you must review and confirm it before filing.

Above the card sits a persistent red banner marked with a warning triangle: "Not yet filable — review required. This is an AI-assisted draft. It will not count as complete and the submission cannot be exported until you review it against the Health Canada guidance and attest it as your own content:" followed by a button "I have reviewed this AI draft — it is my content" ("Recording…" while saving). Until you click it the section stays blocked and export is prevented; the chip reads "AI draft — review & confirm". Once confirmed, the chip reads "AI-assisted · confirmed".

If the AI backend isn't configured, the chat shows a red notice: "AI drafting isn't set up yet (no GROQ_API_KEY). Switch to the \"✦ Fill the form\" tab above to author this section instead, or ask an admin to configure it."

The alternate "Fill the form" tab authors the same leaf from a template form, with its own "Review vs Health Canada" action; either path saves an unconfirmed draft the review banner then blocks until you confirm.
